schema.description: There is no `project_id` or `org_id` here — both come from the path.

type.description:
Decides whether the client can hold a secret. `spa` and `native` are
public — they cannot keep one confidential in a browser or a shipped
binary, so they use PKCE and are refused a secret at the database
level.

**Immutable after creation.** Changing it would either strand a secret
on a now-public client or leave a confidential one with none.
type.title: ApplicationType

allowed_origins.description:
Browser origins permitted to read responses obtained with this
application's tokens. Empty by default, which means none — see
`Application.allowed_origins`.

grant_types.description:
Defaults to `["authorization_code", "refresh_token"]`. `implicit`
and `password` are refused for every type: both hand credentials or
tokens to places that cannot protect them, and OAuth 2.1 removes
them.
